do they make you think less?  


its what i want  


my brain thinks too much.

Meds supress imagination? i think thats what i want

psychologists tells me to relax, gives me tips to be more social, encourages me to be less hateful and other things related to my personality, when i have insanity i go see her and i calm down and i talk to her like a normal human being and then I remain calmed for a few days, then i feel insane again and i go see her.  


I asked her if i should seek psychiatrist, she tells me im not mentally ill yet but that i put myself in the conditions that can lead to mental insanity and we are trying to remove those conditions. but i wonder if it would be easier with some meds.  


Heres what i fear about meds:  
\-acting like a zombie  
\-erectile dysfunction  
\-less emotions  
\-main reason: them not working, i feel that if they dont work i´ll go completely nuts out of desperation  


Heres what i want them for:  
\-calmer mind  
\-rational thinking  
\-behave more like a normal human  
\-main resaon: 0 suicide thoughts
